_doc: probe_attacks.py checks for the scherzo (score qn; bar b starts at qn 3(b-1)). c00 port: ref = isolated attacks after a rest of 1 qn or more, spread over the movement: timpani strokes (limit 0.12 s, as Movement I: strokes start TIMP_DELAY_S after the onset) at bars 3, 91, 149, 303, 363; pizz. at bars 3 (Vc), 89, 185, 241 (Vc), 341 (Cb), 253 (Vln II, Vla); harp plucks at 81, 185, 341; Violins I staccato theme entries at 13 and 253 (0.10 s); the bar-101 brass entry (Tpt 1, Tbn 1, Tuba). opening: the bar-1 G sharp (Hn 1, Violins I ppp). legato: Movement I's c42 limits (robust SD of the perceived attack over each string section's legato joins, tools/pcx.py). No holes or sustain checks yet (no string tremolo entries in this score). After the c00 render: Violins I 756 replaced by Violins I 90 (bar 31, after a 3 qn rest): at 756 the staccato E5 starts on time (-61 -> -44.7 dB in the first 50 ms frame) but the accented G5 at 759, 0.7 s later, sets the 1.5 s peak, so the threshold fell after the first note (probe artefact, +0.39 s reported).
